page_title: GEN 1-1 FRO | Genoa v Frosinone 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+6' The Frosinone players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Juan Luca Sacchi. NO PENALTY!
90+4' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Frosinone as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
90+3' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) handles the ball inside the penalty area. PENALTY to Frosinone! Let's see who will take responsibility.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) makes a strong challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul.
85' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
83' Substitution. Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) replaces Matias Soule.
83' Substitution. Walid Cheddira makes his way off the pitch and Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) comes on as his replacement.
76' The game has come to an end for Reinier. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone).
76' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Milan Badelj is replaced by David Ankeye (Genoa).
76' The substitution is prepared. Morten Thorsby (Genoa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Stefano Sabelli.
74' Neat passing move from Frosinone in order to create new attacking opportunities.
71' 44:56 – the ratio of ball possession.
68' Junior Messias (Genoa) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
67' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
63' Ruslan Malinovsky just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Kevin Strootman (Genoa) replaces him.
61' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
60' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi had an easy-decision to make.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Frosinone.
59' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Frosinone! Play can continue.
58' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Frosinone. Let’s see what happens!
54' Alberto Gilardino is forced to make a change. Mateo Retegui (Genoa) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ridgeciano Haps.
50' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' The referee blows his whistle as Reinier (Frosinone) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' Half-time substitution. Alberto Gilardino decided to make a change. Djed Spence is replaced by Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Juan Luca Sacchi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Milan Badelj (Genoa) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

43' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Josep Martinez is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
42' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Mateo Retegui (Genoa) for his blatant foul.
42' Reinier (Frosinone) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

39' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but his attempt went well wide of the right post.
39' Frosinone force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
39' A corner kick by Frosinone is thwarted by the well prepared Josep Martinez (Genoa).

36' 1 - 1 Goal! Nadir Zortea displays great vision and sends a pass to Reinier (Frosinone), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
35' Great teamplay by Frosinone as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
33' Matias Soule (Frosinone) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
30' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Stefano Turati no chance!
29' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
29' Poor challenge! Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) is penalised for tripping and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle. It's a penalty for Genoa!
25' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) commits a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul.
24' It looked like the long-range shot by Johan Vasquez (Genoa) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
23' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

21' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
20' Frosinone take a short corner kick.
19' A quickly taken corner by Frosinone.
17' Matias Soule (Frosinone) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit.
16' Frosinone take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
15' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) inside the box.
11' Genoa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
10' Stefano Turati somehow managed to stop a header by Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) from a rebound which would have ended in the top left corner.
10' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Johan Vasquez (Genoa) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
10' The ball goes out of play. Genoa are awarded a corner kick.
9' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
8' Stefano Turati is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Junior Messias (Genoa). Easy save!
6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Frosinone comes to nothing.
6' Frosinone can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
5' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range. Frosinone get a corner.
4' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick to Frosinone.
2' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Genoa will have the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi is introduced as the referee for today's match.
